zh-CN.failed: 启动未完成，请处理提示中的配置文件后重新打开 Jeemi。
zh-CN.title: Jeemi 配置文件错误
zh-CN.invalid:
以下配置文件的内容、字段或版本不符合要求：
{{file}}
zh-CN.invalidOffset:
以下配置文件无法解析（字节位置 {{offset}}）：
{{file}}
zh-CN.confirmMessage:
是否删除此文件并继续启动？该文件中保存的设置或资源将丢失，客户端会使用缺省配置继续启动；关联配置可能需要重新设置。

选择“是”：仅删除上述文件并重新检查。
选择“否”或关闭对话框：保留文件并退出，供你自行修复。
zh-CN.otherError: 客户端初始化失败。请检查数据目录是否可访问，以及程序文件是否完整，然后重新启动。

en-US.failed: Startup did not complete. Fix the configuration file shown in the dialog and reopen Jeemi.
en-US.title: Jeemi configuration file error
en-US.invalid:
This configuration file has invalid contents, fields, or a version that is not supported:
{{file}}
en-US.invalidOffset:
This configuration file could not be parsed (byte offset {{offset}}):
{{file}}
en-US.confirmMessage:
Delete this file and continue startup? Settings or resources stored in this file will be lost. Jeemi will continue with defaults; linked configurations may need to be adjusted.

Yes: delete only the file above and check again.
No or close this dialog: keep the file and exit so you can repair it manually.
en-US.otherError: Client initialization failed. Check that the data directory is accessible and the application files are intact, then restart.
